hook: Trump, Xi, Putin: one table, first time
caption:
🤝 Trump, Xi and Putin met at one table for the first time, in Shenzhen at APEC. No major breakthroughs.
🛢️ They pledged more oil products to keep energy flowing. A promise for now, so watch fuel supply.
☢️ They backed talks on nuclear risks. The last US-Russia arms treaty expired in February.
⚖️ They warned bodies like the ICC not to "abuse their jurisdiction" and called for UN reform.
🔢 Warheads: China 600+, the US and Russia over 5,000 each.

Can three rivals at one table actually cut nuclear risk? Tell us below 👇
